summary.text: Frances Ann Hurley is the Democratic candidate for the Illinois State Senate, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Christine McGovern for a seat with no incumbent.
A former Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for District 35, she took office in 2013 and left on February 28, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Frances Ann Hurley graduated from Mother McAuley Liberal Arts High School in 1978 and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Saint Xavier University, according to Ballotpedia.
Before entering the legislature, she was an aide to Aldermen Ginger Rugai and Matthew O'Shea.
Hurley represented Illinois House District 35 from 2013 to 2023, and was re-elected in 2022 over Republican Herbert Hebein with 62.0 percent of the vote.
Her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session included Cities and Villages, Labor and Commerce, Public Utilities, and Police and Fire, which she chaired.
She advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary for the State Senate seat on March 17, 2026, with 27,235 votes.
